title: Plus, Minus or Nothing Between the Digits

concept.title: Three choices in every gap: plus, minus, or glue the digits together
body: Between two neighbouring digits you may write `+`, `-`, or **nothing** (the digits then belong to the same number). From `123` you can make `1+2+3`, `1+23`, `12-3`, `123` and so on. A search that builds the expression from left to right chooses, at each position, **how long the next number is** (one digit, two digits, ...), and then which sign comes before it.

Passing `total` and `expr` **by value** to the recursive call means there is nothing to undo afterwards. The loop `break` is placed on the leading zero rule: once a number would start with 0 and have a second digit, all longer pieces from this start are invalid too. The expressions are compared as text: `+` (code 43) comes before `-` (code 45), and both before the digits.

statement: You are given a string of digits and a target. Write the digits in order and put `+`, `-` or nothing between neighbouring digits (a run of digits without a sign is one number; a number does not start with 0 unless it is just `0`). The expression has no sign in front of its first number. Print every expression whose value is the target, in ascending text order, one per line. If there is none, print `-1`.
inputFormat: The first line has the digits.
The second line has the target.
outputFormat: The expressions in ascending text order (the character + comes before -, and both come before digits), or `-1`.

examples.note: Of the nine expressions only 1+2+3 has the value 6.

hints: At each position choose how many digits the next number has.
A number with more than one digit cannot start with 0.
Pass the running total and the text of the expression to the recursive call; the first number has no sign.

explanation: At each position the loop extends the next number digit by digit (stopping at a leading zero), and the recursion adds or subtracts it. The expression text and the total are passed down, so nothing needs to be undone. Complete expressions with the right value are collected and sorted.
solution.complexity: Time O(3^(n-1) * n), space O(n) besides the output.
